baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active participle لَّابِثِينَ, the locative فِيهَا, and the temporal plural أَحْقَابًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: A continuing resident-state is stretched across successive age-spans: place supplies the state, while the plural temporal accusative supplies its repeated measure.

activation_trace.role: The image of staying in a place gives لَّابِثِينَ its literal, durative residence function.
The image of an extended age gives أَحْقَابًا successive temporal units over which residence continues.

changed_reading.after: They are profiled as continuing residents whose occupancy is measured again and again in age-spans.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The combination of لَّابِثِينَ and أَحْقَابًا, read through their stoppage branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: Delay in the resident-root and withholding in the age-root converge, changing a merely large duration into a condition defined by failed release.

activation_trace.role: Delay and slowness make the participial stay feel arrested rather than neutrally residential.
Withholding or stoppage makes the age-spans function as repeated non-release.

changed_reading.before: The verse states a very long stay.
changed_reading.after: The verse depicts duration as detention: what persists across the ages is the stoppage itself.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَحْقَابًا beside the place-bound participle لَّابِثِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The non-temporal girth and rear-bag branches of ح ق ب coexist with its temporal branch, allowing the ages to carry a faint image of successive bindings or loads that keep the residents in place.

activation_trace.role: Staying in a place supplies the stationary state to which the tether/load images attach.
Tying with a girth supplies a constraining image for the plural أَحْقَابًا.
Carrying or storing behind supplies a burden image that can accompany, without replacing, the temporal sense.

changed_reading.before: أَحْقَابًا is only a plural measure of time.
changed_reading.after: The age-spans can also register as successive restraints or carried burdens fastening the residents to their place.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding sequence makes the focus location an intentionally prepared endpoint: a watched or prepared station becomes their return-place, and the focus participle extends arrival into detention across ages.

activation_trace.role: Staying in a place supplies the continuing occupancy that follows arrival at the prepared endpoint.
Extended ages turn occupancy at that endpoint into a sentence-like duration.
Preparation and setting in readiness make Hell an arranged receiving station rather than an accidental location.
Returning to a place makes the station a terminal destination whose consequence is prolonged residence.

structural_cues: 78:21-23 forms a tight location chain: Hell as مِرْصَادًا, for the transgressors as مَآبًا, followed by لَّابِثِينَ فِيهَا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preparation, return-to-place, and immediate sequence. I infer that the endpoint functions as detention; the live alternative is simply long residence at a destination without an institutional or carceral nuance.

changed_reading.before: They happen to remain in Hell for ages.
changed_reading.after: They arrive at a prepared return-station whose designed consequence is age-spanning detention.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first presents mountains as solid peg-like stabilizers and later displaces those same mountains into mirage. Against that collapse of apparent permanence, the residents' continuing stay becomes the grim invariant.

activation_trace.role: Place-bound staying supplies the persistence that remains after the world's anchors cease to hold.
Age-spans extend that persistence beyond the surrounding transformations.
The solid elevated mass supplies the initial image of natural permanence.
Peg-like upright stability sharpens the mountains' anchoring function before its reversal.
Displacement and removal reverse the earlier anchoring action.
The same solid-mass image identifies precisely what loses its stability.
Occurrence in time supplies a transition into a new state, contrasting with the focus participle's sustained state.
Mirage-like appearance completes the conversion of a solid anchor into unstable semblance.

structural_cues: 78:7 and 78:20 repeat ٱلْجِبَالَ around a stability-to-mirage reversal; 78:19-21 also repeat finite كَانَتْ transformations before the durative participle in 78:23.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same mountains as pegs, then as displaced mirage, plus a durative focus participle. I infer a contrastive invariant in which penal residence outlasts cosmic solidity; the alternative is that the scenes are sequential without making that contrast salient.

changed_reading.before: The residents stay for an immense duration.
changed_reading.after: Even the world's apparent anchors are unfastened and become semblance, while their penal residence alone persists through age after age.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, stillness is a restorative interval within an alternation: sleep and rest yield to night/day ordering and livelihood. The focus's delay-plus-withholding branches turn age-spanning residence into exclusion from that renewing cycle.

activation_trace.role: Delay and slowness supply a stoppage that no longer behaves like a bounded restorative pause.
Withholding makes each age register continued non-release from the arrested condition.
Literal sleep supplies the ordinary bounded state of inactivity.
Rest and stillness give that inactivity a restorative function rather than a punitive one.
Night and darkness supply one half of the created alternation.
Day's opening by light supplies release into the alternate phase.
Life and livelihood name the productive outcome to which the ordinary cycle returns.

structural_cues: 78:9-11 moves from sleep/rest through night to day/livelihood, whereas 78:23 gives an unbroken plural of ages with no alternating release named.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a created rest-work alternation and focus branches of delay and withholding. I infer that the punitive stay is an arrested cycle; the live alternative is a simple contrast between worldly rhythms and afterlife duration without a cycle mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They remain for a sequence of long periods.
changed_reading.after: They are held outside the created rhythm of rest and renewal, with every age extending the same unreleased stoppage.

context_deltas.mechanism: Beneficent circulation earlier delivers water, pours it out, and produces growth. Immediately after the focus, cooling and drink are denied and replaced by hot or dark outflow. This activates ح ق ب as withholding, making the ages periods of blocked life-giving circulation rather than bare chronology.

activation_trace.role: Staying in the place makes the altered water regime an enduring habitat rather than a momentary exposure.
Withholding, including withheld rain, supplies the material blockage that the context's water contrast activates.
Delivering water by irrigation or pouring supplies the earlier beneficent flow.
Pouring and outflow intensify the image of freely released water.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the life-producing result of that circulation.
Coolness opposed to heat names the relief now withheld.
Taking in liquid names the sustaining intake now denied.
Hot water supplies the harmful replacement for cooling and drink.
Flowing and outpouring preserve circulation in an inverted, noxious form.

structural_cues: 78:14-15 links poured water to growth; 78:23-25 links age-spanning residence to denied coolness/drink and harmful liquids.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies released water and growth, then the focus withholding branch followed by denied and inverted fluids. I infer a blocked hydrological life-cycle; the alternative is that these are independent benefit and punishment images without a shared circulation model.

changed_reading.before: أَحْقَابًا quantifies how long punishment lasts.
changed_reading.after: Each age is a renewed interval in which life-giving circulation is withheld while only harmful flow remains available.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fixed judicial appointment leads into fitting recompense, accounting, exhaustive enumeration, and an imposing record. These cues recast the plural ages as adjudicated units within an exact sentence, not an unstructured synonym for vastness.

activation_trace.role: Residence supplies what the judicial system orders and maintains.
Age-spans supply countable sentence units rather than only an undifferentiated long time.
Judgment separating right from wrong establishes the legal transition into the focus condition.
Fixing by a time or limit gives the judgment an appointed temporal frame.
Answering an act with its recompense makes duration consequential rather than arbitrary.
A measure equal to its counterpart supplies proportional calibration.
Counting and accounting supply the assessment the residents had not expected.
Exhaustive numerical enumeration removes the possibility of untracked residue.
Inscription that imposes judgment or destiny turns the accounting into an enforceable record.

structural_cues: 78:17 appoints the day of decision; 78:26-29 moves through fitting recompense, rejected accounting, exhaustive counting, and record.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies judicial separation, timing, proportional recompense, counting, and record. I infer that this exactness also qualifies the plural age-spans; the live alternative is that only deeds and recompense are counted while أَحْقَابًا remains rhetorically indefinite.

changed_reading.before: The plural ages evoke indefinite immensity.
changed_reading.after: The ages read as imposed and accounted sentence-units inside a fully recorded economy of fitting recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later command to experience punishment, followed by increase and an exceptive restriction to punishment alone, turns plural ages from repeated empty duration into an additive sequence: continuation carries intensification.

activation_trace.role: Successive age-spans provide the temporal slots across which increase can accumulate.
Experiencing or undergoing something makes each temporal slot embodied rather than abstract.
Increase and growth supply the directional arrow from one period to a more intense next state.
Painful punishment specifies what alone is added.

structural_cues: 78:30 follows the focus unit with فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا, an explicit increase construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plural age-spans and an explicit later increase restricted to punishment. I infer accumulation across the spans; the live alternative is intensification of punishment without any period-by-period temporal mapping.

changed_reading.before: Every age prolongs the same punishment.
changed_reading.after: The age-spans form an experiential sequence in which continuation admits no addition except further punishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same return-place word frames two routes: the transgressors' return-place immediately precedes the age-long stay, while the closing invitation lets one will and take a return toward the Lord. The focus duration becomes the consequence of one route rather than undifferentiated fate.

activation_trace.role: Staying in a place supplies the consequence attached to the first return destination.
Extended ages show how radically the first destination constrains the traveler's future.
Return to a place names Hell as the route endpoint directly governing the focus stay.
Will directed toward a thing supplies volition at the alternative route's opening.
Taking or acquiring supplies the active adoption of the alternative route.
The repeated return-to-place image marks the second endpoint and makes the route contrast lexically visible.

structural_cues: مَآبًا occurs at 78:22 immediately before the focus and again at 78:39 in the volitional construction فَمَن شَاءَ ٱتَّخَذَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two return-place occurrences, one followed by confinement and one governed by willing and taking. I infer a route bifurcation; the live alternative is that the repetition contrasts destinations without defining a strict two-route system.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives a self-contained statement about duration in Hell.
changed_reading.after: The age-long stay is the locked consequence of one return route, set against a return that can still be deliberately taken.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two parallel negated clauses define what can occur فِيهَا in the punitive and rewarded domains. The focus's own فِيهَا therefore becomes more than a locator: age-long residence means subjection to a place-specific sensory rule-set.

activation_trace.role: Staying in a place binds the residents continuously to that domain's rules.
Age-spans extend exposure to the domain-specific regime.
Literal tasting supplies the first regulated sensory channel.
Coolness supplies the relief excluded from the punitive domain.
Liquid intake supplies the second excluded channel in the punitive domain.
Hearing sounds supplies the corresponding regulated channel in the rewarded domain.
Discarded, inconsequential material specifies what hearing excludes there.
Falsity specifies the second excluded auditory content and completes the parallel rule-set.

structural_cues: 78:24 and 78:35 share the frame لَا + sensory verb + فِيهَا + object + وَلَا + object, but populate it with punitive deprivation and rewarded purity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated locative-negation syntax and contrasting sensory contents. I infer that places operate as sensory regimes and that residence entails subjection to one; the alternative is rhetorical parallelism without a general domain mechanism.

changed_reading.before: فِيهَا merely identifies where the long stay occurs.
changed_reading.after: فِيهَا identifies a closed experiential domain whose punitive sensory constraints hold over every age of residence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-temporal rear-bag branch of أَحْقَابًا through the closing image of deeds sent forward by the hands. It remains valid as a spatial polarity anchored in the focus root and exact context branches, but downstream prose should call it an exploratory front/behind resonance, not translate أَحْقَابًا as baggage.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The rear-carried or stored branch of ح ق ب in أَحْقَابًا, alongside the place-bound لَّابِثِينَ.

activation_trace.role: Staying in place supplies the destination at which the carried consequence is borne.
Bagging or carrying behind supplies the rear-load pole of the spatial resonance.
Advancing or sending forward supplies the opposite spatial pole and links prior action to later residence.
What the two hands earn identifies the forwarded material as one's own accumulated deeds.

changed_reading.before: The residents face a long future unrelated to the closing image of past deeds.
changed_reading.after: What their hands sent ahead meets them at the destination as an age-spanning consequence that is also faintly imaged as a load borne behind.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the surface كَذَّبُوا means denial while the cited inventory branch preserves an idiom glossed by 'did not tarry.' It remains anchored through that explicit branch image and the focus's delay branch, but it should be rendered only as a lexical-inventory reversal: denial associated with non-tarrying is answered by prolonged tarrying, not as the verse's direct lexical meaning or a proven causal rule.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The delay and slowness branch of ل ب ث in لَّابِثِينَ.

activation_trace.role: Delay and tarrying supply the prolonged consequence side of the reversal.
The branch image 'did not tarry to do' supplies an anti-delay resonance inside the root used for their emphatic denial.

changed_reading.before: Their denial and their long residence are separate statements.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory branch level, denial carrying a non-tarrying idiom is reversed into a consequence whose defining feature is tarrying through ages.

strongest_changes: The immediate lookout and return-place sequence turns long residence into prepared destination-detention.
The whole-surah water sequence activates ح ق ب as withholding: beneficent flow and growth are replaced by age-long denied relief and harmful flow.
Judgment, timing, fitting recompense, enumeration, and record recast the plural ages as adjudicated and accounted units.
The repeated return-place at 78:22 and 78:39 makes the focus stay the consequence of one route, contrasted with a return that can be deliberately taken.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made the brief focus verse function as a hinge among created cycles, cosmic de-anchoring, destination processing, sensory regimes, exact accounting, and the closing image of deeds sent ahead. The most productive surprise was that the non-temporal withholding and rear-load branches of ح ق ب could alter the temporal reading without displacing it.
remaining_uncertainties: The temporal age branch of ح ق ب remains primary; withholding, tether, and rear-load readings are co-activations rather than replacement glosses.
The surah clearly counts deeds and recompense, but applying that exact accounting directly to the number or boundaries of the ages remains an inference.
The arrested-cycle and sensory-domain models depend on structural contrast; the same sequences can be read as parallel rhetoric without a shared mechanism.
The denial anti-tarry reversal is deliberately retained as branch-distant and should not enter unqualified commentary.
